item: Encrypted is said only on evidence everywhere, and the at-rest record keeps a MAC of page 1, never its bytes
summary: R821: every surface that says a store is encrypted (the unlock attestation, doctor and status, benchmark, performance, the encrypt tool, ui_clickthrough --require-encrypted) needs a keyed open in this process or the app's record naming that very file; a header alone reads looks encrypted, not yet checked with your key, and the encrypt tool never skips, never says complete and never overwrites on a guess. R828: a record entry is dev, ino and an HMAC-SHA-256 of the file's first 16 bytes under a random binding key in the record, never the salt (legacy head fields scrubbed on open); the erase overwrites and unlinks the record right after page 1 and before the logs, keys and bulk work (the coordinator's order, the same on the plaintext path), and a failure to destroy it is reported as key material possibly remaining; the record and its lock are never carried by a backup, export or bundle; an entry goes when its file is erased, replaced or decrypted. Strings x12.
